لَا طِئَةٌ A wound on the head, such as is termed سِمْحَاقٌ: (K:) also termed ↓ مِلْطَأٌ and ↓ مِلْطَأَةٌ [q. v. infra]. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, A pustule (K) that comes forth upon a man, scarcely curable; (TA;) said to be from the sting, or bite, of the ثُطْأَة. So in the L; but in the K, incorrectly, or it is from the sting, or bite, of the ثطاة. (TA.) ―
-b3- Also, A small kind of قَلَنْسُوَة, that cleaves to the head. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
